# EchoRank

> EchoRank (echorank360.com) is an AI reputation intelligence platform operated by
> ChatLogic Insights Ltd (England and Wales, company 15593166). It audits AI
> visibility, tracks what AI assistants answer about businesses daily, and computes
> an explainable 0 to 100 Reputation Risk Score with revenue-at-risk estimates.

## Reference documentation

- [Le guide complet de la visibilité dans l'IA en 2026 (French)](https://echorank360.com/fr/guide-visibilite-ia): reference manual on AI Visibility Optimization (AVO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Includes the EchoRank scoring framework, a 10-point readiness checklist, industry guides, a glossary and an FAQ.
- [User guide (English)](https://echorank360.com/en/guide): full product documentation.
- [Guide d'utilisation (French)](https://echorank360.com/fr/guide)

## Methodology notes

- The Reputation Risk Score combines five weighted components: negative pressure (0.40), review velocity (0.25), recent critical signals (0.15), AI visibility (0.15), stagnation (0.05). Weights are those of the current model version and every driver behind a score is named.
- AI answer tracking runs configured customer questions against major AI engines daily and archives each response, producing a dated time series of citations, misrepresentations and absences.
